title: Open standard for cross-game achievement system to gamify onchain participation

ms.promise: Create an Achievement System PRC (Paima Request for Comment) defining the achievement standard. PRCs work similarly to CIPs (Cardano Improvement Proposals) or ERCs, but are for the Paima ecosystem.
ms.criteria: A properly written and reviewed specification on how to handle achievements in Paima covering all key points including making easily indexable, self-hostable and readable from the game itself

ms.promise: Build a proof-of-concept of the achievement system and host the code on Github
ms.criteria: Implement the PRC in at least 1 game/minigame and have completion of the achievement be visible from website that is part of the code on Github, with more games to come in future milestones as the system becomes more stable.
ms.report:
In response to PoA comments:
NOTE: We have resubmitted before completing the review as we have an update where we have discussed certain key topics with the Catalyst Directive. You will find the text bellow in comments. 
NOTE 2: We have added a video, and simplified the documentation to show the contents of the milestone.
Thank you for the review. 
(1) Direct value on Cardano. The games funding model locks Cardano native tokens to pay for player transactions: an allocation of cNIGHT is held across 30 dedicated Cardano wallets, registered with their stake addresses to generate the resources that cover user interactions - Cardano is the economic engine of the games. The wallet addresses are public on-chain (example below), and the open-source tooling we built to manage those registrations is published. Additionally, Cardano SPOs can opt in as Midnight block producers, so activity on these games generates direct value for the Cardano ecosystem.
(2) Scope. The proposal was not changed - it was expanded. Rather than simple examples, the PRC standard is implemented in a real working portal and real games, all open source, all compatible with Cardano: the tooling to retarget the stack at Cardano is a configuration change in the code.
Brief:
Proof of concept of the open achievement standard. PRC-1 defines two HTTP endpoints any game can serve - one listing the achievements a game offers, one reporting what a given wallet has earned - so any website can display progress for any game that speaks the standard. PRC-6 extends it with channels, leaderboards, metrics, and identity resolution for auto-sign sessions. The standard is implemented in three live games (Safe Solver, Kachina Kolosseum, Block Kart Legends), and the midnight.fun portal aggregates achievements across all of them, visible next to each wallet. Each game's repository contains both the minigame integration and the achievement-display frontend.

ms.report:
NOTE: Due to short timelines for this project, we have submitted this milestone before the previous was approved. This was discussed with the Cardano Directive, and a formal statement was added at the end of the PoA
BRIEF
This milestone delivers the webpage for the cross-game achievement system: the front end that reads the PRC achievement endpoints and renders, for any wallet, the achievements it has earned across games. The design system was specified in Figma and implemented as the public games portal at midnight.fun/games, which pulls achievement and leaderboard data live from each game's PRC endpoints - no central database, the portal queries each game's node on the fly. It is open source and, built on EffectStream.

ms.report:
NOTE: Due to short timelines for this project, we have submitted this milestone before the previous was approved. This was discussed with the Cardano Directive, and a formal statement was added at the end of the PoA. This milestone is totally independent.
BRIEF
This milestone delivers the public release of the achievement system with three live games implementing the PRC standard - Safe Solver, Dust-2-Dust, and Block Kart Legends - all surfacing their achievements and leaderboards on the midnight.fun portal. The prior review noted Kachina was not yet integrated; it is now live alongside the other two. A player earns an achievement in any of the games and it appears on the portal next to their wallet, across all three. Open source, and chain-swappable to the Cardano ecosystem by configuration.
NOTE the open sourced UI from the previous milestone was forked and reimplemented to match the style of the brand
